'''November 2000 Minneapolis tournament (21 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Minneapolis, Minnesota on 21 November 2000. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1487">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-22-minneapolis-mn-11-21-00d1487/ minneapolis-mn-11-21-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 22 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-22-minneapolis-mn-11-21-00d1487/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
